assertions.assertion: The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229)
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-197
prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered

The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia, occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
as documented in the clinical indication note
The payer letter itself acknowledges that the appeal must include supporting clinical documentation
which is provided below to justify the medical necessity of this diagnostic procedure
